services.name: Architecture Tours
services.desc: The tour that started it all. We’ll give you the Chicago River and throw in Lake Michigan for good measure. This boat tour starts with a close-up of the skyscrapers on the river, then opens to the lake via the Chicago Lock for another wow-factor perspective, all in 90 minutes. Architecture, meet open water. Wendella's 90 Minute Lake & River Architecture Tour takes you from deep in the city out onto the lake for the most complete view of Chicago. It’s the tour that started it all for us, and it’s still a crowd favorite. Expect fun facts, real-deal history, and iconic architecture up close on this Chicago River and Lake Michigan boat tour. blurb: Wendella offers a variety of boat tours and cruises on the Chicago River and Lake Michigan. Guests can enjoy guided architecture tours, sunset cruises, wine and cheese cruises, and fireworks cruises. The company operates year-round with climate-controlled vessels and experienced guides.

quotes.author: Elizabeth
quotes.text: The BEST tour guides on the Chicago River! I've been on the Wendella boats for the Chicago River Architecture Tour several times and it's been fantastic every time and worth every penny!

quotes.author: Jason
quotes.text: I've done the Wendella Boat Tour four times now whenever friends or family visit, and it's always an awesome experience. This is a must-do if you're in Chicago.

quotes.author: Krupa
quotes.text: The Wendella architecture tour came highly recommended to us when we moved to Chicago. I will say the hype is real.

quotes.author: Mathis
quotes.text: The tour and guide were fantastic. Everything was clear and engaging, we didn't even notice the time flying by

quotes.author: Katherine
quotes.text: I loved the tour guide; she was funny while still being educational.

quotes.author: Florian
quotes.text: We learned alot and enjoyed the beauty of downtown from the water.
